name: Autódromo José Carlos Pace

sources.geometry: OpenStreetMap highway=raceway ways (ODbL, Overpass API), Taubin-smoothed
sources.width: Published/approximate: ~15 m pit straight, ~14 m Senna S / Reta Oposta, ~12-13 m infield
sources.elevation: Copernicus GLO-30 DSM (copernicus-dem-30m.s3.amazonaws.com, tile S24 W047), robust-median + smoothing
sources.pit: OpenStreetMap way "Pit Lane" (33779109): entry before Junção-exit climb, exit after the Senna S
sources.corners: Official turn numbering from F1 live-timing circuit data (MultiViewer API circuits/14/2026) fitted to the centreline; names from OSM raceway:corner_number tags
sources.trim: Medium downforce: long full-throttle climb from Junção to Turn 1 and the Reta Oposta balanced by a twisty infield
sources.pitLimit: F1 80 km/h (Sporting Regulations default, São Paulo GP event notes); WEC 6 Hours of São Paulo 60 km/h
sources.pitLoss: F1 green-flag pit loss ~21.8 s from F1 live-timing derived circuit data (MultiViewer API); WEC unknown
sources.raceLaps: F1 2026 São Paulo GP: 71 laps; not a sprint weekend in 2026

notes: Anticlockwise. Start/finish line placed at the start gantry visible on Esri World Imagery opposite the pit building (approximate). Elevation from a 30 m surface model: broad shape only.
